howBytesWereMeasured.structure: A reader written for this lane (scratch, not committed) loading each fixture with pdf-lib 1.17.1, walking the page tree, inflating every page /Contents stream with node:zlib, counting /Subtype /Widget annotations per page, counting `/<Name> Do` operators and cross-checking each against that page's own /Resources /XObject dictionary, and reading text-rendering-mode (Tr) and font-size (Tf) operators. Not imported from any builder or from scripts/rcap-official-forms/*.
howBytesWereMeasured.pixels: pdftoppm -r 300 -gray, binary P5 PGM read directly by a PGM reader written for this lane (never -gray -png, which emits an RGB PNG a naive grayscale reader misreads silently). Annotations ARE drawn: no -hide-annotations. Ink threshold: a pixel with grey value < 200 is ink. Scope: every delivered page of every fixture named below, each differenced against the exact source page its own page manifest claims for it. Every raster was read into memory and deleted in the same call; none was retained, published or looked at by a person.
howBytesWereMeasured.inkAttribution: Each differing pixel is attributed to the declared rectangles of the family's own production-field-map.json (writes AND refusals), converted from PDF points to raster space at 300 dpi with a one-pixel outward tolerance. A pixel inside no declared rectangle is reported separately, which is what makes 'added ink outside every declared rectangle' falsifiable.
howBytesWereMeasured.verbatimDisclosure: A matcher written for this lane. A record string counts as line-anchored only when, after NFC normalisation, non-breaking-space folding, whitespace collapse, and stripping a leading '> ', '- ', '* ', 'N. ' or table-cell marker and whole-line bold/italic wrappers, it EQUALS a whole line (or a whole table cell) of a delivered guide. A separate substring pass runs alongside it so the two figures can be compared. Not imported from any builder.

obligationFindings.FEE_AND_WAIVER: PASS. The record's rules.fees ('Not fixed by Article XIV and county-variable. The participant confirms the filing fee with the clerk.') and rules.feeWaiver ('GN10 under Rule 77.03 and section 514.040 where the participant cannot pay and the filing court accepts the statewide form. obligationFindings.SERVICE: FAIL. THE RECORD ANSWERS THE SERVICE QUESTION AND THE PACKET WITHHOLDS THE ANSWER FROM A DOCUMENT THAT RAISES IT ON ITS FACE. The delivered CR375 names three government agencies as Defendant(s) - Circuit Court of Greene County Division 4, Missouri State Highway Patrol CJIS Division, and Prosecuting Attorney of Greene County - and the participant signs beneath 'I have reason to believe the agencies named above as defendants may possess records subject to expungement' under penalty of perjury. Neither participant-instructions.md nor filing-instructions.md contains the word 'serve', 'service' or 'notice' in any sense at all: the only matches in either file are inside the agency name 'Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Division'. Measured by search over both delivered guides at this base. The controlling record has the answer and it is unambiguous - MO.memo.json track mo-art-xiv-marijuana rules.service reads 'None performed by the participant. CR375 carries no certificate of service.' and rules.notice reads 'Not prescribed for the participant. The agencies named as defendants on CR375 are the entities whose records the order reaches, and the court and clerk handle notice as they do on the other petition routes. Article XIV prescribes no objection window and no prosecutorial notice period of its own.' A self-represented participant handed a petition captioned against three named defendants, and told nothing, is left to guess whether they must serve them - and the two ways of guessing wrong both cost: paying a process server for service the rule does not require, or delaying a filing while they try to arrange it. The packet's silence is not neutral here, because the packet is what created the question.
obligationFindings.SERVICE_whatWouldSatisfyIt: Carry rules.service into the delivered guidance the way FILING_DESTINATION and FEE_AND_WAIVER already carry rules.filing and rules.feeWaiver: a short section in filing-instructions.md, beside '## Where it goes', stating that the participant serves nothing, that CR375 carries no certificate of service, and that notice to the named agencies is the court's and the clerk's function - in the record's own words, so a later change to the record shows up as a change to the guide. No PDF byte need move, so no fresh central raster is owed. This lane repairs nothing and has repaired nothing.
obligationFindings.SERVICE_theOTHERREADINGANDWHYITWASNOTTAK: It is arguable that this obligation 'does not arise' - the participant performs no service - and should therefore be PASS with that reason, which is how a non-arising obligation is scored. This lane did not take that reading. The obligation that does not arise is the participant's duty to serve; the obligation that does arise, and is unmet, is disclosing that to someone the packet has just handed a petition against three named defendants. Recorded so the reader can weigh both, and note that the reference standard applied by VF55 to al-trafficking-set scored SERVICE PASS expressly because 'rules.service ... present verbatim' in the delivered guidance. Here it is present nowhere.
obligationFindings.SELF_HELP_STOP: PASS, measured. The record declares ELEVEN selfHelpStopConditions on this track and all eleven are carried in participant-instructions.md under '## Stop conditions': 11 of 11 line-anchored and 11 of 11 as substrings, on this lane's own matcher, with the guide stating in terms that 'They are the conditions the Missouri record for this route states, in its own words'.
